problem: Lack of institutionalization of decentralized urban sanitation systems in India
solution: Sanitation Capacity Building Platform (SCBP) initiative by NIUA, promoting decentralized sanitation solutions through collaborative networks and capacity-building events
technology: Decentralized sanitation systems, ODF/ODF+/ODF++ framework, and tools for sanitation service assessments and faecal sludge management (FSSM)
outcome: Institutionalized decentralized sanitation systems that are socially, economically, politically and scientifically sustainable
